description: This file defines the API for accessing PFR-specific data in the FreeType font rendering library, including functions for retrieving metrics, kerning, and glyph advances for PFR fonts.

methods.name: FT_Get_PFR_Metrics
methods.description: Retrieves outline and metrics resolutions, and scale factors for a PFR font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_PFR_Kerning
methods.description: Returns kerning vector between two glyphs in a PFR font.

methods.name: FT_Get_PFR_Advance
methods.description: Returns the advance width of a glyph in metrics units for a PFR font.
